name: Grilled beef loin
summary: Thăn bò is grilled with nấm or with cải tai mèo. The national desk says the meat is soft and sweet, with a chili heat from the greens.
origin: The town grill piece, after the lake-stall list.
taste: The page says the loin is ngọt and mềm, with a cay note from the cải. That is the page’s line.
howToEat: Grilled over charcoal, with mushroom or with cải tai mèo. A price is Check on arrival.
where: The piece places the grill stalls at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market, then names this loin. The hour is Check on arrival.
